source_uses.fact: DfT Circular 01/2022 governs National Highways engagement with plan-making and decision-taking and does not itself prove site access capacity
Local Plans should be supported by a robust transport evidence base considering impacts, accessibility, viability and infrastructure requirements
The borough Transport Strategy supports Local Plan growth, air-quality improvement and travel-behaviour change
LIP3 is the borough strategy for delivering transport-system improvements
The Infrastructure Delivery Plan assesses current provision and future infrastructure requirements
Draft London Plan 2026 includes MBUL5 Sustainable Transport to enable London’s Growth
Draft London Plan 2026 separately addresses utilities capacity, connectivity and resilience under MBUL4
Draft London Plan statutory consultation is open July to October 2026; draft policy must not override adopted policy before adoption
MD3515 approved the Draft London Plan for 13-week statutory consultation beginning 16 July 2026
Adopted London Riverside OA identifies strategic potential for 44,000 homes and 29,000 jobs by 2041
Barking Riverside current official page records updated 2026 outline consent for 20,000 homes and planning status Consented
Draft 2026 annex gives London Riverside indicative capacity of 38,000 homes and 31,400 jobs to 2050 and remains draft context

examples: Strategic-road-network policy does not prove a junction or access can serve a specific parcel
A Local Plan transport evidence base is plan-level evidence, not a parcel traffic-capacity result
LBBD Transport Strategy supports growth but requires scheme-specific access and mitigation evidence
LIP3 delivery priorities are not a guarantee of parcel-level transport works
London Riverside 44,000-home capacity is strategic opportunity-area evidence, not parcel yield
Barking Riverside 20,000-home consent is site-level consent context and cannot be transferred to neighbouring parcels
Draft London Riverside 2050 capacity cannot override the adopted London Plan while consultation is ongoing
No promotion without exact parcel relation plus scheme-specific access, highway-capacity and mitigation evidence
